lines.t: [Intro Instrumental Built Up]
[Trumpets and Horns sounding]
(Verse 1)
The watchmen rise upon the walls,
The night grows thin, the silence calls.
A force moves over land and sea,
The Word stands firm eternally.
The proud have fallen, kingdoms sway,
But dust returns to dust one day.
From hidden places, hearts are stirred,
Awakened by the living Word.
(Pre-Chorus)
Lift your eyes, the hour is near,
The voice of truth cuts through the fear.
What was written now unfolds,
What was promised still holds.
(Chorus)
When the horn of truth is sounding,
When the drums of heaven roar,
We will stand on solid ground,
Steadfast as the days of old.
When the light confronts the darkness,
When the line is drawn,
We will move at His command,
Till the night is overthrown.
[Instruments in the background]
(Verse 2)
The nations rage, the earth responds,
Yet all are held within His palms.
Not by the strength of mortal flame,
But by the power of His name.
He gathers those who hear His voice,
Refines the heart, confirms the choice.
Through fire and trial, truth is known,
A people shaped to stand alone.
(Pre-Chorus)
Set apart, awake, made sure,
Anchored fast, refined and pure.
What He has spoken will not fail,
His counsel stands, His truth prevails.
(Chorus)
When the horn of truth is sounding,
When the drums of heaven roar,
We will stand on solid ground,
Steadfast as the days of old.
When the light confronts the darkness,
When the line is drawn,
We will move at His command,
Till the night is overthrown.
[Instrumental Solo]
(Bridge — Final Build)
From the beginning, He has spoken,
To the end, His word returns.
He reveals, He shakes, He gathers,
Every heart He weighs and judges.
The faithful stand, the double-minded fall,
Truth alone will judge it all.
What is built on sand will break,
What is sealed in Him will stay.
(Final Chorus - Full Cinematic Rise)
Let the horn of truth be lifted,
Let the drums declare His way.
Every lie will be scattered,
Every shadow swept away.
From the dawn into the evening,
From the earth into the skies,
All creation bears His witness,
Truth and light forever rise.
(outro)
The war was not of flesh or ground,
But of the heart where truth is found.
What He has spoken shall remain,
Unbroken word, eternal reign.
